chinese_prompt_files: review translations only; never sent to the models
launch_update: User authorized starting ten cases: local Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct and GLM with ten independent processes; stop manual monitoring after valid startup evidence.
source_policy: All ten use their original seed2 recorded attempt, not later Oracle reruns.
checkpoint_selection: Existing review.decision_frame, before that frame's action command.
error_endpoint: Last nonterminal nonreused frame at or before existing review.highlight_end_frame.
image_sampling: Uniform by observation index, including both interval endpoints; no model-based frame selection.
evaluation: Frozen prior semantic expected/actual labels; separate evidence-backed review maps each model's branch IDs to labels. JSON validity is not semantic correctness.
primary_metric: Correct selected task branch / all 10 fixed samples, after all outputs are reviewed; abstentions and request failures are unsuccessful decisions.
secondary_metrics: inventory includes correct and wrong routes
scope: Conditioned on a previously marked crossing and a known erroneous attempt; no crossing detection, physical reset, action execution or final navigation success evaluation.
